documents.title: Apparel and Footwear Return Window
documents.text: Apparel and footwear items are eligible for return within 7 days of delivery when the item is unused, undamaged, and has its original tags and packaging. The return request must be raised within the applicable return window shown on the order.

documents.title: Electronics Return Window
documents.text: Eligible electronics products may be returned within 10 days of delivery when the item is defective, damaged, or the wrong product was delivered. Some electronics may require brand-authorized inspection or troubleshooting before a return is approved.

documents.title: Home Products Return Window
documents.text: Eligible home products can generally be returned within 7 days of delivery when the product is unused and in acceptable condition. Large or installed items may require inspection before reverse pickup or refund approval.

documents.title: COD Refund Timeline
documents.text: For an eligible cash-on-delivery order, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes the required verification step. Once initiated, the refund is normally credited to the bank account or other approved destination within 5 to 7 business days.

documents.title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
documents.text: For an eligible prepaid return, the refund is initiated after the returned product passes verification. The amount is normally credited back to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days after refund initiation.

documents.title: Standard Delivery SLA
documents.text: Standard delivery is targeted within the estimated delivery date displayed for the order. Delivery estimates can vary by seller, destination, inventory location, and logistics conditions.

documents.title: Delayed Delivery Handling
documents.text: When an order passes its displayed estimated delivery date, the customer can use the order support flow to request an update. A delayed shipment may receive a revised delivery estimate based on the latest carrier and seller information.

documents.title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
documents.text: Reverse pickup is available when the return request is eligible and the product is serviceable for pickup at the delivery address. Pickup can be unavailable in some locations or for items requiring customer drop-off instead.

documents.title: Damaged Product Return
documents.text: A product reported as damaged on delivery should be reported within the return or replacement window shown for the order. The support process may request photographs or other evidence before approval.

documents.title: Wrong Product Received
documents.text: If the delivered product does not match the item ordered, the customer should raise a return or replacement request within the applicable product window. The returned item may be inspected against the order details before the resolution is completed.

documents.title: Non-Returnable Items
documents.text: Some products may be marked non-returnable because of hygiene, safety, personalization, or other category restrictions. The product page and order page should be treated as the source of the item's specific return eligibility.

documents.title: Refund After Reverse Pickup
documents.text: After a successful reverse pickup, the returned item may undergo verification before the refund or replacement is finalized. The applicable refund timeline begins after the required verification and refund initiation steps.

documents.title: Replacement Eligibility
documents.text: A replacement may be offered instead of a refund when the product and seller support replacement for the reported issue. Replacement availability depends on stock, product category, location, and the applicable order policy.

documents.title: Return Condition Requirements
documents.text: Returned products should normally include the relevant accessories, tags, manuals, and original packaging where applicable. Products that show misuse, missing required components, or material damage may fail verification.
